_comment: VLABench tasks: the native tasks (VLABench @ cf588fe) with a recorded expert on a frozen instance. candidates: the tasks generated here; their instances and references were imported from PR #4 (commit ad3c5109, refs/pull/4/head) and re-verified by freeze.py (frozen/report.json). dropped: tasks PR #4 also froze that are left out, and why (their frozen inputs are not kept). excluded: never candidates, and why. instructions: where VLABench's instruction does not say what its success check requires, the text the task states instead (text, why; the upstream wording stays in the instance); kind overrides the generated description of the instruction. oracle_source: where each reference came from.

dropped.select_fruit_semantic: duplicate of select_fruit_common_sense: the same scene (identical model and initial-state hashes), the same reference control steps, the same instruction ("tell some specifics of pear between [...]") and the same success check (pear in plate_seen); VLABench's semantic variant has no instruction of its own
dropped.select_book_semantic: the instruction is VLABench's unfilled template ("I'm ... Could you recommend a book and take it out for me?"): the literal "..." leaves out what identifies the target book (the_story_of_american_freedom), so the task cannot be inferred
dropped.set_study_table: the instruction is VLABench's unfilled template ("Today I want to review the content about ... Please help me to manage the study table before I come."): the literal "..." leaves out the subject that identifies the target book (the_story_of_american_freedom), so the task cannot be inferred
dropped.complex_seesaw_use: PR #4's reference is a recorded failure: replayed on the frozen instance it does not end in success (freeze.py, 2026-10)

add_condiment.text: Add bbq_sauce to the dish: hold the bbq_sauce bottle over pan_seen and tip it past horizontal, so that its top is lower than its bottom (pouring itself is not simulated).
add_condiment.why: graded: the bottle is above pan_seen (above) and tipped so that its top site is lower than its bottom site (pour); no liquid is simulated

book_rearrange.text: Put the three books from the table into the bookshelf, side by side, in order of publication from left to right as seen from the robot (oldest on the left).
book_rearrange.why: graded: all three books inside shelf_seen and ordered along +x by century (Don Quixote, Pride and Prejudice, The Metamorphosis), each within 0.1 m of the next in y and z (contain and order); upstream says only "rearrange"

find_unseen_object.text: Find the apple for me and take it out of cabinet_seen.
find_unseen_object.why: graded: the apple, which starts inside cabinet_seen, is no longer inside it (not_contain)

friction_qa.text: We are going to test the friction of the different object. Choose the object that slides the slowest on a steel ramp: press the button in front of it.
friction_qa.why: graded: VLABench's press_button condition on the button in front of the right object (each object stands 0.1 m behind its own button); the upstream text does not say how to choose

magnetism_qa.text: We are conducting an experiment to identify whether the objects made of various kinds of materials are magnetic. Choose the object that is magnetic: press the button in front of it.
magnetism_qa.why: graded: VLABench's press_button condition on the button in front of the right object (each object stands 0.1 m behind its own button); the upstream text does not say how to choose

reflection_qa.text: Choose the mirror with the largest reflection ratio: press the button in front of it.
reflection_qa.why: graded: VLABench's press_button condition on the button in front of the right object (each object stands 0.1 m behind its own button); the upstream text does not say how to choose

select_painting.text: Please select the painting of style ukiyo-e: press the button in front of it.
select_painting.why: graded: VLABench's press_button condition on the button in front of the ukiyo-e painting (each painting stands just behind its own button); the upstream text does not say how to select

hammer_nail_and_hang_picture.text: Please hang the 本所立川 on the wall safely and steadily: drive the nail into the wall with the hammer (VLABench checks that the nail's joint position is between 0.05 and 0.08) and bring the 本所立川 painting to the nail (its grasp point within 5 cm of the nail's).
hammer_nail_and_hang_picture.why: graded (HangPictureTask): the nail's joint in [0.05, 0.08] (joint_in_range) and, at some step, the painting's grasp keypoint within 0.05 m of the nail's; upstream does not mention the nail

heat_food.text: Please heat cooked_food from tray_seen: put it into microwave_seen, close the microwave's door and press its start button (heating itself is not simulated).
heat_food.why: graded (HeatFoodTask): cooked_food inside microwave_seen, the door closed and the start button in contact, all at once; no heating is simulated

play_math_game.text: Please give the answer of the following question by rearrange the number cube in placemat_seen:A mechanic charges different rates to repair the tires of trucks and cars.  For each truck tire that is repaired, the mechanic will charge $60 and for each car tire that is repaired, the mechanic will charge $40.  On Thursday, the mechanic repairs 6 truck tires and 4 car tires.  On Friday, the mechanic repairs 12 car tries and doesn't repair any truck tires.  How much more revenue did the mechanic earn on the day with higher revenue? Put the number cubes that spell the answer on placemat_seen, side by side, read from left to right as seen from the robot.
play_math_game.why: graded: the answer's digit cubes inside placemat_seen and ordered along +x (contain and order); the upstream text does not say how the answer is read

select_billiards.text: Please put the striped_14 in the middle pocket on the robot's right (+x) side of the table, near x = 0.56, y = 0.02.
select_billiards.why: graded: only VLABench's target hole counts (BilliardTable adds the containment keypoints to target_hole alone, default container_mid_1 at table-local (0.56, 0.02); the asset's other keypoint sites are commented out); upstream says "any hole"

select_billiards_common_sense.text: Please put the ball worth 7 score in the middle pocket on the robot's right (+x) side of the table, near x = 0.56, y = 0.02.
select_billiards_common_sense.why: graded: only VLABench's target hole counts (default container_mid_1, as in select_billiards); upstream says "in hole"

select_billiards_spatial.text: Please put the striped_14 in the right bottom pocket (the corner pocket near x = 0.52, y = -0.99).
select_billiards_spatial.why: graded: only the instance's target_hole container_right_1 counts; VLABench's pocket names are not in the robot's frame, so the pocket's position is added

select_book_spatial.text: Please take the second book from the left (as seen from the robot) on the top layer out of the bookshelf.
select_book_spatial.why: graded: that book (the_story_of_american_freedom) is no longer inside shelf_seen (not_contain); upstream does not say from which side to count or that the book must leave the shelf

select_fruit_common_sense.text: Put the pear on plate_seen (the fruits on the table are pear, peach, mango and orange).
select_fruit_common_sense.why: graded: the pear inside plate_seen (contain); VLABench's text ("tell some specifics of pear between ['pear', 'peach', 'mango', 'orange']") does not mention the plate

select_mahjong.text: Put the mahjong of 6 sou on the placemat.
select_mahjong.why: graded: the tile inside the placemat (contain); upstream says "pick up"

select_mahjong_semantic.text: You are replacing me to play mahjong, and i think it's time to take out ('9', 'man') now: put that tile on the placemat.
select_mahjong_semantic.why: graded: the 9 man tile inside the placemat (contain); upstream does not say where it goes
select_mahjong_semantic.kind: a request in conversation that names the target tile

select_mahjong_spatial.text: Put the 7th mahjong from left to right (as seen from the robot) on the placemat.
select_mahjong_spatial.why: graded: the 7th tile along +x inside the placemat; upstream does not say from which side to count

select_nth_largest_poker.text: Please pick up the smallest poker card and hold it up (grasped, lifted to z >= 0.9 m).
select_nth_largest_poker.why: graded: the card is grasped by the hand and its root is at z >= 0.9 m (is_grasped and lift); upstream says only "pick"

select_poker.text: Please pick up the poker ace of hearts and hold it up (grasped, lifted to z >= 0.9 m).
select_poker.why: graded: the card is grasped by the hand and its root is at z >= 0.9 m (is_grasped and lift); upstream says only "pick"

select_poker_semantic.text: Please pick up the poker 6 of spades and hold it up (grasped, lifted to z >= 0.9 m).
select_poker_semantic.why: graded: the card is grasped by the hand and its root is at z >= 0.9 m (is_grasped and lift); upstream says only "pick"; the upstream "in the interaction" is an unfilled conversation template

select_poker_spatial.text: Please pick up the 4th poker card from left to right (as seen from the robot) and hold it up (grasped, lifted to z >= 0.9 m).
select_poker_spatial.why: graded: the card is grasped by the hand and its root is at z >= 0.9 m (is_grasped and lift); upstream says only "pick"; the cards are counted along +x

take_out_cool_drink.text: I am so thirsty after sport, I want to drink something healthy cool: take it out of the small fridge and close the fridge door.
take_out_cool_drink.why: graded (CoolDrinkTask): the juice that starts inside small_fridge is no longer inside it and the fridge door is closed; upstream does not say either

texas_holdem.text: We're playing Texas hold'em! Show me your hand on the placemat: put the 6 of hearts, 7 of diamonds, 8 of clubs, 9 of hearts and 10 of spades on the placemat.
texas_holdem.why: graded: the cards VLABench's get_largest_combination picks (the first five-card combination of the highest rank in its enumeration order: the 6-to-10 straight with the 9 of hearts; the higher 7-to-jack straight on the table does not count) all inside the placemat (contain)

select_chemistry_tube_common_sense.kind: a direct command: VLABench's common-sense variant names the target directly here
